title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
script:
Eugenia Kuyda built Wabi to realize an idea she first pitched twelve years ago.
She is the founder of Replika.
She originally pitched this assistant concept on stage at Disrupt back in two thousand fourteen.
Her newest startup offers a personal AI assistant designed to handle daily tasks.
The application is entirely free and downloadable for anyone today.
Would you let Wabi manage your daily routine?
